parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The node type. This parameter is required if you configure the whiteIpList parameter. Valid values:

*   WORKER
*   KIBANA

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
The update mode. Valid values:

*   Cover (default): overwrites the IP addresses in the specified IP address whitelist with the IP addresses specified by using the ips parameter.
*   Append: adds the IP addresses specified by using the ips parameter to the specified IP address whitelist.
*   Delete: deletes the IP addresses specified by using the ips parameter from the specified IP address whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained for the whitelist.

parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description:
The network type. This parameter is required if you configure the whiteIpList parameter. Valid values:

*   PRIVATE
*   PUBLIC

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch modify-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-0pp1jxvcl000z0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --node-type WORKER --network-type PUBLIC --modify-mode Cover --white-ip-list 192.168.xx.xx --white-ip-group '{"groupName":"test_group","whiteIpType":"PRIVATE_ES","ips":["192.168.xx.xx"]}' --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
